title: Workbook Unit 2 — Section C

items.label: C1
items.promptEn:
(give / a presentation / to)
She had a chance __________________________________.

items.label: C2
accept: I have nothing to say about it.

accept: He was sorry to hear the news.

accept: He sang a song to please her.

Ben was __________________________________ at the market.
accept: Ben was happy to buy fresh fish at the market.

items.promptEn:
(buy / a shirt / to)
She went to the store __________________________________ for him.
accept: She went to the store to buy a shirt for him.
